get.description: BGP Community Lists configuration. A BGP Community is a 32-bit value used to classify and group routes for policy application. This container manages three types of Community Lists: Standard (specific community values), Expanded (regular expression patterns), and Extended (route targets and extended community formats). Each list contains ordered entries with permit or deny actions for route classification and policy enforcement

BGP Community List definition with a unique name and type specification. parameters.description: Key combination of community-list-name and community-type separated by ~

ArubaCommunityList_CommunityListsSchemaG.description: BGP Community Lists configuration. A BGP Community is a 32-bit value used to classify and group routes for policy application. This container manages three types of Community Lists: Standard (specific community values), Expanded (regular expression patterns), and Extended (route targets and extended community formats). Each list contains ordered entries with permit or deny actions for route classification and policy enforcement

community-list.description: BGP Community List definition with a unique name and type specification. Each list contains an ordered sequence of entries with permit or deny actions and community values in the format specified by the list type: Standard (specific numeric community values), Expanded (regular expression patterns), or Extended (extended community values and route targets for VPN and EVPN services)

community-list-entry.description: Community list entries with permit or deny actions. Each entry specifies community values or patterns to match in BGP routes. Entries are processed sequentially by sequence number

community-expanded.description: Regular expression pattern to match BGP communities in expanded format. Patterns can include community values and regular expression metacharacters for flexible matching

community-standard.description: List of standard community values. Includes BGP well-known communities (INTERNET, NO_EXPORT, NO_ADVERTISE, LOCAL_AS, GSHUT) and custom AS:NN format communities

items.description: List of standard community values. Includes BGP well-known communities (INTERNET, NO_EXPORT, NO_ADVERTISE, LOCAL_AS, GSHUT) and custom AS:NN format communities

route-target-expanded.description: Regular expression pattern to match extended community route targets in expanded format. Patterns can include route target values and regular expression metacharacters

route-target-standard.description: List of standard route target extended communities. Used in MPLS VPN environments for route target filtering in AS:NN format

items.description: List of standard route target extended communities. Used in MPLS VPN environments for route target filtering in AS:NN format
